observations.behavior: Removes the call to `_redact_secrets` and the helper `strip_oauth2_permanent_marker` from the OAuth2 permanent error handling, replacing them with a call to `_oauth2_token_error_message`.
observations.posthog_connection: This change removes the redaction of secrets from the error message returned to the user when an OAuth2 token request fails permanently. This could expose the client secret or refresh token in the error message if the implementation of `_oauth2_token_error_message` does not strip them, potentially leaking credentials to the user or support team.
